assets.prompt: I'm making buff and debuff icons for my fantasy MMO. The attached image is one of our existing icons. Every icon I ask for in this chat must match its art style exactly: a gritty hand-painted dark fantasy illustration, one bold central subject seen up close, a near-black background with embers and smoke, strong rim light, a hot glow in the element's colour, high contrast so it still reads when shrunk to 40 pixels, the subject filling the square. Always square 1:1, painted edge to edge, no text or letters, no border or frame, no rounded corners, no UI. Make one image per message, straight away, with no questions. Icon 1. Name: Hammer's Weight. What it does: a tank debuff from the Guardian of the Hammer, a stone giant; its crushing blow leaves the tank taking 100% more physical damage until the other tank takes over. Paint: a colossal carved stone hammer slamming down onto a cracked steel shoulder pauldron, ochre-gold light bleeding from the cracks, the plate buckling under the weight. Palette: ochre and gold light on dark stone and steel.
assets.review: First output accepted; the owner approved it in the 2026-11-19 audit at 128px, 40px and 28px.
